name: Andou Roza
source:
A quiet junior student.
She always wears headphones in the school and has a laptop.
She is rumored to be an android at school because she is impressed and impressed, and because of her appearance.
She's actually an unofficial but brilliant genius hacker who has been asked to work by the government. Her code name is "AND-63".

She's a bit unconventional, she's nicknamed "Stripper Rosa" because she can't see her surroundings when she concentrates on her work, and she has a weird habit of taking off her laptop while messing around in her dormitory. have.

"Huh ... hacking, done"
